# Eventbrite

> Eventbrite is a comprehensive event management and ticketing platform enabling organizers to discover attendees, sell tickets, market events, and process payments across diverse event categories.

Eventbrite serves event organizers and attendees across the United States with tools for ticket sales, event marketing, payment processing, and virtual event hosting. The platform specializes in ticketing solutions for music, conferences, nonprofits, performing arts, food and drink events, and corporate gatherings.

## Key Topics

- Ticket Sales
- Event Marketing
- Event Promotion
- Event Management
- Payment Processing
- Ticketing Platform
- Event Organizer Tools
- Event Discovery
- Eventbrite Ads
- Virtual Events
- Attendee Management
- Marketing Tools
- Event Hosting
- Social Media Integration
- Conference Management

## Core Platform & Ticketing

- [Eventbrite - Discover the Best Local Events & Things to Do](https://www.eventbrite.com): Eventbrite homepage for discovering local events across US cities
- [Sell Tickets Online With Free Event Ticketing Platform | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/sell-tickets): Eventbrite's core ticketing platform for event organizers
- [Event Payment System | Collect Money for Events | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-payment): Payment processing system for event ticketing and collections
- [Event Organizer: Become an Event Hosting Legend | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/organizer/overview): Event organizer tools overview with ticketing and marketing

## Event Marketing & Promotion

- [The Best Event Marketing Platform: Tools To Grow Your Brand | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/event-marketing-platform): Event marketing platform with social media and promotion tools
- [Eventbrite Ads: Promote Your Events and Beat the Competition | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-ads): Eventbrite Ads product for event promotion and ticket sales

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Sell Music Tickets Online For Your Event | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/music): Music and concert ticketing solution with Bandsintown integration
- [Sell Concert Tickets Online With Eventbrite | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/music-venues): Concert and music venue ticketing platform
- [Create Conferences Your Attendees Will Love | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/conferences): Conference management software with analytics and marketing
- [Performing Arts Ticketing Software to Delight Your Audience | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/performing-arts): Ticketing software for theater, dance, and performing arts
- [Food and Drink Event Ticketing to Delight Your Guests | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/food-drink-event-ticketing): Ticketing platform for food, drink, and festival events
- [Sell Festival Tickets: Event Solutions for Fairs & Festivals | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/festival-solutions): Festival and fair ticketing with vendor management tools
- [The Best Nonprofit Ticketing Software for Event Organizers | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/npo): Specialized ticketing and fundraising tools for nonprofits
- [The Best Ticketing Platform to Grow Your Corporate Events | Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/l/eventbrite-for-business): Corporate event ticketing and management platform
